description: Static, version-agnostic config for the unified surgical-lineage merge pipeline. Per-run inputs (expansion, manifests, version) are passed as args; this file holds only stable structure. Adding a new merge destination = one data edit to modules.route_map, never a code copy.

component_report._comment: single_component was DEMOTED from a blocking invariant to a reported metric (V17-INVARIANT). It was being satisfied only by three miscoded institution->person direct_training edges acting as sole bridges for small islands (Yale 3-node, the ABEA pair, a Society of University Surgeons pair) — edges that actually encode degree attainment, not training — so enforcing connectivity created standing pressure to author false edges. Connectivity is now REPORTED with a threshold alert, never blocking. Values below reflect the CURRENT graph (1 component, no islands); the V17-B1 merge task updates them to expected_components=4, max_island_size=3.
